# list -json should generate output on stdout
bolero list -json ./...
stdout .
# list -f should generate output on stdout
bolero list -f '{{.}}' ./...
stdout .

# test passing first -json then -f
! bolero list -json -f '{{.}}' ./...
stderr '^bolero list -f cannot be used with -json$'

# test passing first -f then -json
! bolero list -f '{{.}}' -json ./...
stderr '^bolero list -f cannot be used with -json$'
